title: Unlawful continuance.
officialText:
No person shall with knowledge or notice of a vacate order allow, authorize, promote, continue or cause to be continued any occupancy or use covered by the vacate order.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
